# gh merge

> gh merge is a GitHub CLI extension that merges every open pull request GitHub can merge, in the current repo, one repo (-R), every repo you own (--all) or every repo of a user or org (--owner). It skips drafts and conflicts and ignores CI status. It is safe for AI coding agents: it never prompts without a terminal, needs --yes to merge non-interactively, has --dry-run and --json, and documented exit codes. MIT licensed, written in Go.

## Install

- gh: `gh extension install Gitguy268/gh-merge`
- Homebrew: `brew install gitguy268/tap/gh-merge` (run `brew trust gitguy268/tap` first on new Homebrew); this gives the `gh-merge` command with the same flags
- Go: `go install github.com/Gitguy268/gh-merge@latest` (also `gh-merge`)

## Use

- Preview: `gh merge --dry-run --json` (add `--all`, `--owner NAME` or `-R owner/name`)
- Merge after the user agrees: same command with `--yes`
- Exit codes: 0 done, 1 error, 2 not confirmed, 3 some PRs skipped or failed
- Agent skill: `gh merge install-skill` (Claude Code, Codex, opencode, ~/.agents)
